feat(mcp): address the rules and decisions as resources (S43, ADR-074)

A client that wanted to browse what this tool is authoritative about had
no way to do it: every answer came back from a tool call with an argument
in it. A rule and a decision record are addressable now, one URI each, with
the byte size they will cost stated up front because that is the one number
a client cannot get without spending the read.

Both revisions of the resource specification were read rather than
recalled, and they disagree about the behaviour that decides whether a
client retries or gives up: a missing resource is -32602 on 2026-07-28 and
-32002 on the two older ones, and neither lets a server answer with an empty
contents array, which reads as a rule with no body. So the error is the
revision's own rather than one code for all three.

The capability is declared unconditionally as the empty object: every rule
and every decision ships with the package, so there is always something to
read, and this server can honour neither subscriptions nor change
notifications. It used to be gated on a property of the tools array that
nothing ever set, which was a promise a client waits on forever, only
quieter.

Every URI is validated, so a refusal cannot be told from a miss and used to
probe the filesystem, and a decision body is redacted on the way out
because a resource travels further than the CLI was aimed at.
f2p: mcp: a decision record is readable and carries no estate name
mcp: a missing resource is the error its revision specifies
mcp: a rule is readable, with its frontmatter reconstructed
mcp: a uri that is not ours, or tries to escape, is refused
mcp: every revision lists rules and decisions
mcp: only the newest revision carries the cache fields on a list
mcp: templates are listed, and they name the two schemes
mcp: the resources capability is declared without subscriptions
p2p: mcp: --list answers without reading stdin
mcp: 2026-07-28 is stateless, so a per-request _meta replaces the handshake
mcp: a malformed request is a request error
mcp: a notification produces no response at all
mcp: a per-request version this server does not speak is refused, by name
mcp: a real session answers on the protocol channel and nothing else
mcp: a tool that fails is a RESULT with isError, never a protocol error
mcp: an older client keeps the revision it negotiated, without being asked again
mcp: an unknown method is a protocol error, not silence
mcp: an unknown tool is a method error naming the way to discover it
mcp: an unsupported protocol version gets ours, not an echo of theirs
mcp: every command that writes is reachable only from the CLI
mcp: every supported revision completes a handshake
mcp: every tool answers, and every answer matches the schema it declared
mcp: every tool declares a usable schema
mcp: initialize answers with the protocol version and the read-only instruction
mcp: invalid JSON is answered, and the session continues
mcp: list results carry a cache lifetime from 2026-07-28 and nothing before it
mcp: no mutating command is exposed as a tool
mcp: ping answers an older client and is refused to a 2026-07-28 one
mcp: rules_why answers both directions, over a real session
mcp: server/discover advertises the revisions, the capabilities and the identity
mcp: skills_brief and `skills brief` answer the same question identically
mcp: the annotations say what the tools are
mcp: truncation is announced in the text, never silent
